summary: Cable One, Inc. filed an 8-K on June 22, 2026, disclosing it commenced an offer to exchange MBI Term Loans for cash, new first lien first out (FLFO), and new first lien second out (FLSO) term loans. The exchange tiers depend on lender participation levels: if early participants exceed 50.01% of outstanding MBI Term Loans, they receive pro rata cash (25.005%) and FLFO loans (25.005%) plus FLSO loans for the remainder; otherwise, each early participant gets 50% cash and 50% FLSO loans. No board recommendation or advisor named. Mechanics involve a new FLFO Facility and FLSO Facility. Watch the participation threshold—risk-arb angle focuses on whether participation reaches the 50.01% cap affecting cash and loan mix.
